author: 水瀬 朔

en.title: A Farewell Note Dissolving in the Sound of the Tide
en.premise: With graduation fast approaching, Nagi spends his days in solitude in a rainy seaside town, harboring feelings he cannot put into words. One day, in a forgotten corner of the school building, he discovers an old letter—unaddressed, yet filled with a desperate, heartfelt longing. Through his connection with the letter's author, a girl named Shiori, Nagi realizes that they are like souls seeking an oasis in a desert, filling the voids in each other's hearts. However, between them lies a boundary of fate that can never be crossed.

zh.title: 溶于潮声的告别便笺
zh.premise: 即将毕业的凪，怀揣着无法言说的情感，在连日阴雨的海边小镇中孤独地生活着。直到有一天，他在校舍的角落里发现了一封古旧的信件。那是一封没有收信人，却写满了切切心愿的信。在与写信的少女——汐里的交流中，凪意识到两人就像在沙漠中寻找绿洲一般，是能够填补彼此内心缺失的存在。然而，在两人之间，却划着一条永远无法交汇的命运分界线。
